recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast studio portrait featuring a male subject in a varsity jacket against a stark white background, with two levels of contrasting sans-serif typography positioned in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head and shoulders dominate the left two-thirds of the frame.
Typography is anchored to the top right, balancing the visual weight of the subject.
Warm skin tones and tan jacket sleeves contrast against the cool black vest and white background.
coreInvariants: Pure white, high-key background with no visible horizon line.
Subject looking directly at the camera with a slight head tilt.
Sharp focus on the face with soft, diffused studio lighting.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject positioned slightly off-center to the left, filling the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the textured, voluminous hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves up to the hair, then across to the right-aligned text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper right quadrant provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subject and background; moderate saturation in skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary display line.
Extremely thin, hairline strokes for the secondary subtitle line.
Wide tracking in the subtitle to match the width of the display line.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Diamond-shaped glyphs used as separators in the subtitle line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast (Bold vs. Hairline) using similar geometric skeletons.
graphicDevices: Small diamond separators between words in the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and tight tracking of the display line.
Provides the necessary hairline weight and clean terminals for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a young man with 1980s styled voluminous hair, wearing a black and tan varsity jacket, looking at the camera against a pure white background. Leave the top right quadrant empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned text in the top right. The top line should be a bold, silver geometric sans-serif. The bottom line should be a black hairline sans-serif with wide tracking and small diamonds between words.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Is there a significant weight difference between the two lines of text?
Does the subject's hair have high volume and texture?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and album title
Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the jacket
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background consistency.
Verify the hairline thickness of the subtitle text.
Ensure the subject's gaze is directed at the viewer.
Confirm the right-aligned typographic block is balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + Off-Center Subject + Right-Aligned Dual-Weight Geometric Typography.
